items: (c) Verify that the belt can be pulled out at a tilt of 15 degrees or less, and cannot be pulled out at over 45 degrees of tilt.

content.text: If a problem is found, replace the assembly.

content.description: Illustration showing outboard rear seat belt being pulled and released with hand motion arrows

content.text: OUTBOARD REAR SEAT BELT [Automatic Locking Retractor (ALR) Type]

items: (a) Pull out the belt, release it slightly and then pull it out again.
(b) Verify that the belt cannot be extended further.

content.text: If a problem is found, replace the assembly.
